note_en: 不但…而且… means "not only… but also…": 不但店面很小，而且装修也十分简单 "Not only is the shop small, but the decor is very plain too." Notice that Chinese keeps normal word order after 不但, whereas English inverts ("not only is the shop…"); 而且 often teams up with 也 or 还 in the second clause.
